public_boundary: Development/test prototype. Public or authorised sources only. No intelligence, surveillance, investigative or operational function. Human Gate remains final for consequential actions.

conditional.claude_adapter: server-side provider configuration and health dependent
conditional.gpt_adapter: server-side provider configuration and health dependent
conditional.governed_hybrid: two independent server-routed responses; no autonomous merge
conditional.web_search: server-side adapter only when configured; must not be simulated
conditional.wpa_knowledge_context: available only when the server response actually provides context/sources

not_active_or_not_verified.reliable_pdf_text_extraction: NOT_ACTIVE; CURRENT PDF PREVIEW IS EXPERIMENTAL

current_public_adapter_contract.rule: Do not silently truncate. Block and disclose when the prompt exceeds the current adapter contract.

truthfulness_rules: A UI label must not imply a provider, database, corpus or scheduler is active unless runtime evidence confirms it.
Model brand labels describe routing preferences, not a guaranteed model version.
A similarity signal is not a plagiarism finding.
An AI review is advisory and cannot replace human editorial authority.
A local preview is not an external AI analysis.
A print-to-PDF flow must not be represented as direct PDF file generation.
RTF export may be described as Word/RTF, but not as a genuine DOCX file.
